original_job.original_steps_yaml:
steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Verify Deep CI source identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          actual="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          tree="$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"
          test "$actual" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test -n "$tree"
          printf 'DEEP_CI_SOURCE_SHA=%s\n' "$actual"
          printf 'DEEP_CI_SOURCE_TREE=%s\n' "$tree"
          printf 'DEEP_CI_EVENT=%s\n' "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Install GNAT
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gnat
      # Hard gate, as in Fast CI: no `|| true`.
      - name: Verify GNAT availability
        run: |
          command -v gnatmake
          gnatmake --version
      # Fetch each pinned release ONCE for the whole job. Both scripts verify
      # the tag revision and root SHA-256 and fail hard on any mismatch; the
      # tests verify the root SHA-256 again before using it.
      - name: Fetch pinned UCI 2.5 and 2.6 (once)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          UCI25="$(scripts/fetch-pinned-uci-2.5.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/uci-2.5")"
          UCI26="$(scripts/fetch-pinned-uci-2.6.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/uci-2.6")"
          echo "AMS_GRA_UCI_2_5_ROOT=$UCI25" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "AMS_GRA_UCI_2_6_ROOT=$UCI26" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      # Marker checks below use here-strings, never `printf | grep -q`: under
      # pipefail a grep that exits on its first match can SIGPIPE a writer that
      # is still emitting a large output and fail a passing check.
      #
      - name: Named TimeZulu pinned inventory and impact (Task 061)
        run: bash scripts/check-task061-pinned.sh
      - name: Real UCI route identity smoke (Task 071)
        run: bash scripts/check-task071-uci.sh
      - name: Pinned semantic schema diff (Task 069, once for both releases)
        run: bash scripts/check-task069-pinned.sh
      - name: Exact IPv6 pinned inventory, impact and real vertical (Task 062)
        run: bash scripts/check-task062-pinned.sh
      - name: Exact patterned integral pinned evidence (Task 063)
        run: bash scripts/check-task063-pinned.sh
      - name: Ada semantic companion naming and smallest real vertical (Task 065)
        run: bash scripts/check-task065-pinned.sh
      - name: Unicode 3.1 pinned profiles, impact and real vertical (Task 066)
        run: bash scripts/check-task066-pinned.sh

  # Independent runner: no artifacts or environment inherited from real-uci.
original_job.expected_header:
concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'oms-main-slot-4' || format('oms-pr-{0}-{1}-{2}-deep-ci.yml-real-uci', github.workflow, github.run_id, github.run_attempt) }}
      queue: max
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 240
